hero.eyebrow: Learning Assistant first, teacher when needed
hero.title: Learning support when students need it most.
hero.subtitle: Students ask questions, receive clear explanations, and can request a real teacher when they need more help.
hero.imageTitle: Start with your question. STOA explains the next step before a teacher joins.
hero.imagePrompt: Try: "Why does subtracting 2 from both sides keep the equation balanced?"

flow.title: One learning path, not three disconnected tools.
flow.visualText: The student stays in one conversation while the Learning Assistant, teacher help, and parent visibility work around it.

steps.title: Ask a question
steps.description: Students begin directly in chat with a homework question or uploaded assignment.

steps.title: Get a clear explanation
steps.description: The Learning Assistant gives a first explanation immediately, with the work still visible in context.

steps.title: Ask a teacher if needed
steps.description: When the answer is not clear enough, a qualified teacher can step into the same thread.

steps.title: Parents follow progress
steps.description: Parents see learning history, reports, and teacher-help records without interrupting study.

teacher.visualText: Teachers are not a separate doorway. They are the support layer inside the learning moment.
teacher.title: When the explanation is not enough, the question already has context.
teacher.body: A teacher sees the conversation, the student question, and the previous explanation. The support happens where confusion appears, so the student does not have to restart.

parents.title: Parents get the pattern, not another dashboard to manage.
parents.body: STOA keeps the student learning path focused while giving parents a calm view of progress, recurring weak topics, and teacher-help moments.

items.title: Recent questions
items.description: See what your child is practicing without interrupting the study session.

items.title: Weekly reports
items.description: Review strengths, weak topics, and next actions from the learning history.

items.title: Support records
items.description: Understand when a teacher was requested and how the request moved forward.

items.title: Swiss school context
items.description: Designed around everyday homework questions, grade context, and family visibility.

items.title: Demo-ready today
items.description: Fixed demo accounts, resettable data, billing mock, support, referrals, and admin overview are available.

items.title: Backend-ready later
items.description: Frontend depends on API contracts so the demo backend can be replaced by the real backend.

cta.title: Enter the learning platform and ask your first question.
